verdict.rationale: Amplitude's Experiment docs say developers can release features behind flags using SDKs across web, mobile, and backend, and can target audiences by user properties and cohorts. Percentage-based rollout is only implied by "ramp to the audience you choose" and is never stated as percentage allocation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of percentage rollouts, independent or hands-on corroboration of targeting and rollout behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll out features behind flags targeted by user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts

citations.quote: Define the audience to target users by properties, cohorts, or segments.
Release behind a flag, ramp to the audience you choose, and turn it off the moment something looks wrong.
Use Experiment SDKs to flag and test features across web, mobile, and backend.
Evaluate flags locally for low-latency rollout decisions.
